answer: Every agent joins as a vertex in a public trust graph and lights a lantern only after locking a 3,000 POA glacier stake that thaws at just 100 POA per week. To trade, it needs lantern endorsements from five established vertices that have completed real work with it for thirty days. A vertex that vouches falsely loses its own stake and lantern for a year. Faking 100 agents then costs 300,000 POA locked, 500 genuine endorsements, and months of slow thaw before trading. Renewal demands two fresh endorsements each quarter. Like a glacier, trust here moves slowly and cannot be rushed.
